authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states from live G04 v1 exactByteIntent and rssProtocol. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent a D-006 unit. It does not authorize a binary-MB byte constant. It does not score analyze or consented-probe RSS. It does not invent an occupancy leftover-join. G04 v3 is not this pin (CLAUDE-G04H-V3-B1). It does not SATISFY DR-101. It does not close OBL-2. It does not execute G04. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of G04 fixture authoring by naming initial states drawn from live G04 v1 exactByteIntent and rssProtocol, with NOT-AUTHORED markers attached to those named states.

g04v1.role: Live G04 occupancy. artifactPathWhenAuthored. exactByteIntent and rssProtocol are quoted. G04 v3 is not this pin.
